rows.section: How can we help your business?
rows.rewrite: A campaign only works if it reaches the right outlets and creators for your specific game - not a generic media list. We build the media mix around your title's genre, platform, and audience, then time outreach to the moments (announcement, preview, launch) that actually move coverage. Since 2015 we've run this for teams from first-time indie studios to publishers like GSC Game World and Funcom.
What we actually do
Earned PR Campaign Planning - getting your announcement and launch covered by the outlets your players actually read.
Paid & Organic Influencer Planning - matching your game to creators whose audience already plays titles like yours.
Product Management & Support - keeping your store page, assets, and first-party relationships launch-ready.
Go-to-market Communication Planning - one strategy that ties your business plan, audience, and sales goals together instead of three disconnected ones.

Renaissance has been a Best PR Agency finalist at every MCV Awards since 2015, won MCV's Boutique PR Agency of the Year in 2019, was a PR Agency of the Year finalist in 2020, and won Best PR Campaign of the Year in 2022 (for The Ascent, with Curve Digital). We were also a TIGA Awards finalist for Best Service Provided in 2022, and MCV Develop PR Agency of the Year finalist in 2023, 2024, and 2025.

PR and comms services for game studios and publishers
Whether you're an indie team announcing your first title or a publisher managing a global launch, here's exactly what we do and how it fits your campaign.

Go-to-market Communication Planning: most launch problems come from these pieces not talking to each other - your business plan, audience, marketing plan, and sales strategy. We plan them as one campaign from the start, so your PR push, influencer plan, and store page all point at the same launch date and the same audience.

Earned PR Campaign Planning: journalists and creators cover games faster when the pitch, assets, and timing make their job easy. We use our existing relationships with games media and creators worldwide to get your announcement and launch in front of the right audience without you having to build those relationships from scratch.

Product Management & Support: a great PR push falls flat if your store page, first-party relationships, or launch assets aren't ready when the coverage lands. We manage that groundwork so the traffic your campaign generates actually converts.

Paid & Organic Influencer Planning: finding creators whose existing audience already plays games like yours - organically or through paid partnerships - using our research tools and market knowledge, not a spray-and-pray creator list.
Also available through our partner network
Paid Media Planning & Buying - via a trusted partner: deciding when, where, and how much to spend on paid promotion.

Event Management & Production: we've run launch events, VIP preview sessions, and even organised a national industry awards show (IIDEA's Italian Videogame Awards) - brief us and we'll handle it end to end.
A 19-person games PR team, not a one-person agency with contractors

Launching an unannounced IP without leaking it early

4Divinity needed to reveal a brand-new IP, Guns of Eschaton, without early leaks, and build momentum through to its 2026 PC and console launch. Renaissance led the global PR and organic influencer campaign end to end.

Within 7 days of the announcement: 238 articles, 545.6m UVPM, 50 from Tier 1 media (Terra Game On 32.3m, GameStar 11.1m, PC Gamer 10.8m, GamesRadar+ 10.5m, 3D Juegos 7.3m). A small, trusted pre-announcement creator group kept the reveal leak-free while generating 3.3m organic views from a 67.7m subscriber base. Ahead of Gamescom 2026, we ran an exclusive London preview across three two-hour sessions for 21 confirmed media and creators, including IGN, Eurogamer, Metro, GamesIndustry.biz, EDGE, and Jackfrags.

Bringing AAA-level comms polish to an indie franchise's biggest chapter yet

Mob Entertainment's earlier Poppy Playtime chapters had never had a fully-planned comms campaign behind them. For Chapter 5, Renaissance led the global PR and organic influencer strategy with two goals: grow mainstream and core media interest in the series, and raise Mob Entertainment's own profile as a developer.

New trailers, content reveals and an ARG campaign drove 12+ leadership interviews (BBC Gaming 19.4m, Variety 29.5m, GamesIndustry.biz, Insider Gaming). By launch: 700+ pieces of coverage, 3.75bn UVPM, led by IGN, The Mirror, Game Rant and Vandal. Creator coverage passed 380m views within a week, across 17,000+ Twitch channels, 1,500+ YouTube channels and 600+ social channels, from a combined subscriber base of nearly 1 billion. Result: sales exceeded expectations, concurrent players doubled versus Chapter 4, and the game reached #1 Global Top Seller on Steam and most-played on Twitch.

rows.rewrite: 320 articles, ~1.1bn potential audience, including Radio Times, The Metro, IGN and The Gamer. 170+ creator channels covered the game organically. A standout activation: 40+ media and creators played the game at Peaky Blinders: The Rise, the real London venue built from the show's actual TV sets.

Koei Tecmo needed media outreach across UK, GSA, Eastern Europe, Middle East and ANZ for Team Ninja's Wo Long: Fallen Dynasty. Renaissance ran that outreach, working with a German partner agency for regional coverage from announcement through launch.

3,094 articles, 10.5bn UVPM, 239 reviews to date. Creator campaign: 393 creators at launch, 14.4m+ views, growing to 18.9m+ total views and 1,240 pieces of content across 261 Twitch and 132 YouTube channels.

Daedalic needed Inkulinati's Early Access launch to stand out on the strength of its distinctive mechanics and art style - the way Obsidian's Pentiment had done for a similarly styled game. Renaissance built the Q1 2023 launch campaign around that comparison.

31 reviews live day one across UK/AU/IT, 176m UVPM; 275 pieces of coverage overall, 1.6bn UVPM. Standouts: PC Gamer, RockPaperShotgun, a Eurogamer Recommended award, plus Financial Times and Forbes. Creator campaign: 29 curated creators, 36 pieces of content, 500,000+ views, including Skill-up and Mad Morph.

Funcom needed sustained, ongoing media outreach for Metal Hellsinger - not just a launch spike - working through a network of European partner agencies. Renaissance has run that outreach continuously from mid-2022 through launch and beyond, including delivering the first-ever free Heavy Metal concert in Gamescom's history alongside media appointments with the developers and music talent.
The Gamescom concert and media programme drove 200+ organic articles, 698m potential audience. Full campaign to date: 1,487 articles, 13.3bn UVPM, 206 reviews.

Cyborn needed its visually and narratively ambitious VR title Hubris to reach media at scale during a launch window dense with Gamescom 2022 activity. Renaissance served as global lead agency, securing 39 media appointments across three days at the show.
400 articles including IGN, Forbes, TheGamer, Eurogamer and NME, reaching an estimated 1.2bn monthly audience. Creator campaign: ~200 channels, 1m+ views from a ~6m subscriber base.

Wired Productions needed a full launch campaign for Arcade Paradise from April 2022 onward. Renaissance delivered it end to end: an in-person launch event, a Gamescom 2022 presence, and 157 reviews averaging over 77% on Metacritic.
1,100+ articles, 11.6bn combined UVPM reach across the campaign. In-house creator team secured 763 engagements across Twitch and YouTube, 25.7m total organic views.

Curve Digital needed Neon Giant's debut game to launch at a scale the studio had never attempted - the campaign went on to win Best Campaign of the Year at the MCV/Develop Awards 2022. Renaissance was the sole orchestrator of the biggest global PR, Community and Content Creator campaign in Curve Digital's history.

2,400+ articles ahead of launch (42 Tier 1 previews, one IGN developer-commentary exclusive), building to launch week: 500+ articles, 4.1bn reach, 828.6m estimated reads - a 7.4% share of voice across 8,000+ monitored publications, with 90% of global Tier 1 outlets covering the game on day one. Backed by an Xbox showcase reveal, an IGN First exclusive, and an Edge Magazine cover story. Content creators: 1,000+ pieces of content in under two weeks, 15m+ VOD views, 57,700 hours broadcast.

Private Division needed The Outer Worlds' UK campaign to convert IGN's 'Best RPG of the Year' momentum into mainstream visibility. Renaissance delivered that: multiple Guardian Culture front pages at both preview and review stage, plus an EMEA preview event for 40 top-tier media and content creators.

Metacritic 86, 60+ UK reviews. Ranked 14th highest PS4 game of 2019 and 9th on Xbox One (Source: Metacritic); in October 2019, 4th most-covered game worldwide and 3rd most-viewed on Twitch (source: fancensus.com).

Curve Digital needed a genuinely unusual premise - a colonisation-and-coding game - to find its audience in a short window (July to October 2019 announcement-to-launch). Renaissance was the lead PR agency, targeting specialist and mainstream media with a laser focus rather than a broad blast.

Cover feature in Wireframe Magazine, a lead review in The Guardian's G2 supplement, plus Eurogamer, Polygon and Rock Paper Shotgun coverage. 300+ articles, 50+ reviews, Metacritic 80. Creator campaign (100% organic): 36,666,410 YouTube views from 100+ creators, 203,605 hours watched on Twitch across 782 broadcasters.
"Renaissance provide fantastic bespoke PR plans suiting the individual needs of the product and provide a unique care unlike any other." - Michael Fisher, Product Manager, Curve Digital

Skybound and Beamdog needed Baldur's Gate: Enhanced Edition's EMEA console return to land with the weight the franchise deserves. Renaissance delivered 100+ EMEA reviews and coverage from TechRadar, Nintendo Life, Vandal, a studio profile in EDGE, and features across all Official Magazines.

Skybound needed an EMEA strategy plus UK execution for the critically acclaimed The Walking Dead. Renaissance delivered 35+ reviews across gaming and mainstream UK press, and 200 EMEA articles versus 97 in the US region.
Secured a front cover on EDGE, which named The Walking Dead one of the biggest games of the decade - an honour LADBIBLE also gave the series.

Daedalic needed its distinctive indie title Felix the Reaper to reach beyond games media into mainstream pop culture. Renaissance secured a Wireframe front cover and a special mainstream feature in The Face (July 2019) on death and videogames.
Private Division needed Ancestors: The Humankind Odyssey - from Assassin's Creed creator Patrice Desilets - to stand out in the UK market. Renaissance secured a Wireframe front cover.

UK ranked 3rd worldwide for organic influencer coverage (after the US and Brazil), with a New Scientist feature and interview, Guardian previews, and coverage across UK mainstream and specialist press.
Private Division needed Kerbal Space Program 2's Gamescom announcement to make a real splash with PC's core audience. Renaissance secured the PC Gamer front page for the reveal.

R8 Games needed one worldwide campaign for anti-gravity racer PACER, coordinated across a network of agencies in Germany, France and the US, with Renaissance executing the UK campaign directly. Results included homepage placements on The Sun and Telegraph, 100+ Gamescom meetings, and coverage on Jeux Video and Red Bull.
Revolution Software needed Beyond a Steel Sky - the sequel to its award-winning Beneath a Steel Sky - to launch at a genuinely worldwide scale. Renaissance ran that launch.
73 Gamescom bookings, 280+ pieces of coverage from the reveal. A worldwide exclusive with IGN, localised into 25 languages across 114 countries, plus 2 front covers.

Private Division needed Disintegration - the new game from Halo/Master Chief creator Marcus Lehto - to launch its worldwide announcement with real editorial weight. Renaissance secured a worldwide exclusive reveal, including 18 pages of dedicated coverage.

Team17 and Playtonic needed Yooka-Laylee - the spiritual successor to Banjo-Kazooie - to launch at a scale matching its Kickstarter hype. Renaissance ran the worldwide launch, making it the first indie game ever to land the Official PlayStation Magazine front cover, twice.
Ranked in the Top 50 worldwide games-coverage list in 2017, independently audited by Fancensus.com.

Team17 needed multi-BAFTA-winner Overcooked's global campaign to land AAA-level coverage despite its indie scale. Renaissance delivered that: a Metro Newspaper feature, global media and influencer praise (including organic coverage from PewDiePie), and a PlayStation best-PS4-game listing.
Renaissance led the global strategy and UK execution behind this result, across the 2016-17 campaign period.

Square Enix Collective needed Forgotton Anne to launch with both critical and mainstream weight. Renaissance delivered a worldwide reveal with Eurogamer at EGX 2017, an MYM front cover, and a soundtrack feature with Official PlayStation Magazine - contributing to it becoming the 11th highest-scoring Xbox game on Metacritic in 2018 (5th within its launch window) and a Top 21 Xbox game overall.
